entities.summary: David Duke Jr. is an American professional basketball player for Bàsquet Manresa of the Spanish Liga ACB. He has previously played for the San Antonio Spurs of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and with the Austin Spurs of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Providence Friars.
